SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
pr.min_price AS minPrice, pr.max_price AS maxPrice,
e.discount_type AS discountType, e.discount_value AS discountValue
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.product_id, MIN(sp.price) AS min_price, MAX(sp.price) AS max_price FROM sku s JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id GROUP BY s.product_id ) pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_type = 'TIME_SALE' AND e.target_type = 'PRODUCT' AND e.target_id = p.product_id AND e.is_active = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT category_id FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
UNION ALL
SELECT c.category_id FROM category c JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.category_id ) SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
pr.min_price AS minPrice, pr.max_price AS maxPrice,
e.discount_type AS discountType, e.discount_value AS discountValue
FROM products p JOIN category_tree ct ON p.category_id = ct.category_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.product_id, MIN(sp.price) AS min_price, MAX(sp.price) AS max_price FROM sku s JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id GROUP BY s.product_id ) pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_type = 'TIME_SALE' AND e.target_type = 'PRODUCT' AND e.target_id = p.product_id AND e.is_active = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT category_id, category_name FROM category WHERE parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY category_id

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.is_customizable, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
pr.min_price AS minPrice, pr.max_price AS maxPrice,
e.discount_type AS discountType, e.discount_value AS discountValue, e.end_at AS eventEndAt
FROM products p
JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.product_id, MIN(sp.price) AS min_price, MAX(sp.price) AS max_price FROM sku s JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.sku_id = ( SELECT MIN(s2.sku_id) FROM sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id ) GROUP BY s.product_id ) pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_type = 'TIME_SALE' AND e.target_type = 'PRODUCT' AND e.target_id = p.product_id AND e.is_active = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at
WHERE p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_id FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.supplier_id AS supplierId, p.product_name AS productName, p.description AS description, p.is_customizable AS isCustomizable,
MIN(sp.price) AS minPrice, MAX(sp.price) AS maxPrice,
e.discount_type AS discountType, e.discount_value AS discountValue, e.end_at AS eventEndAt
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN sku_price sp ON sp.sku_id = s.sku_id
LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_type = 'TIME_SALE' AND e.target_type = 'PRODUCT' AND e.target_id = p.product_id AND e.is_active = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at
WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
GROUP BY p.product_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) FROM products p JOIN event e ON e.target_type = 'PRODUCT' AND e.target_id = p.product_id AND e.is_active = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at
SELECT MAX(e.discount_value) FROM event e WHERE e.event_type = 'TIME_SALE' AND e.discount_type = 'RATE' AND e.is_active = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at
